name: rest_static
description: The aggregations of task 4.1c on static tables: distinct of every column type with and without nulls, with and without keys; unique with every kind of non-unique sentinel for every column type, the refused ones included; count where with match, range, pattern and formula filters, several filters, and the filters Java refuses; an aggregation output with the name of a group-by column; first and last of array and vector columns.
